ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity white/cream pixels concentrated in the distal lobe regions and 60% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels dominating the central and proximal areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetric contiguous white blobs occupy the distal third of both lobes. The right lobe contains a series of high-contrast black vertical streaks within the white field. A yellowish-tan chromatic shift is visible in the upper-medial segments of the light regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a sharply defined vertex; depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency saw-tooth serrations consisting of recurring triangular peaks and valleys along the entire continuous trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to tapered, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, circular tan-colored pixel groups (barnacle colonies) are localized exclusively along the lateral and distal margins of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct, nearly parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible on the white surface of the right distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral colonization by barnacles along the outer edges; prominent dark rake marks on the right lobe pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellow-tan biological film staining overlaid on the high-intensity white pigmentation areas of both lobes.
